title: Perplexity Comet alternatives: browser or bot computer?
h1: perplexity comet alternatives beyond your browser
description: Compare Comet with Dusk Bot: a browser assistant versus a bot with its own computer, including free-plan limits and a dated safety disclosure.
answer: comet is a browser with an assistant that can research, browse and act on pages. dusk bot is an app where a bot can have a browser and desktop separate from yours. keep comet on your shortlist if browser work is the main job. consider dusk if you want the job to belong to a named bot with its own files, memory and routines, rather than choosing a new everyday browser.
og_line: your browser, or a bot's computer.

them: you want an assistant built into a chromium-based browser
you want to import your existing browser setup and use most chrome extensions
you want perplexity's model routing as part of its own plans
dusk: you want a bot's browser and desktop separate from your everyday screen
you want to watch through Screen, take control yourself and hand it back
you want the same bot's job, files and memory alongside ongoing conversations

compare.intro: plan access is as of 12 november 2026. downloading a free browser does not mean browser agent queries are included on the free plan. no browser speed or task-success test is included.

method: we make dusk bot. the comet column uses perplexity's own pages, read on 12 november 2026, and the safety note uses brave's dated disclosure. we did not run identical tasks, test browsing performance or retest the disclosed vulnerability. this is a comparison of working environments and documented access, not a current security certification for either product.

sections.h: put the browser in the right place
sections.md:
comet is a chromium-based browser with a built-in assistant that can browse, research and act on pages.[^1] it fits the question "can an assistant help where i am already browsing?" its docs say you can import from other browsers and use most chrome extensions.[^1]

dusk asks you to organise work around bots. on dusk cloud, each bot gets a desktop. a bot on your own server can have a private desktop there, and on a mac you can deliberately give a bot your own screen.[^6] that is useful when you want to separate the bot's work area from the browser you use yourself. see [ai that controls a computer](/ai-agent-that-controls-your-computer) for that broader way of working.

sections.h: free download and agent access are different
sections.md:
as of 12 november 2026, perplexity's plan help page says the free plan has no browser agent queries. pro and max have monthly limits.[^4] we couldn't confirm the current pro price or its query allowance on perplexity's pages, so we don't guess them here.

dusk's free personal desktop use still involves whatever your ai provider charges. dusk cloud pays for a computer that stays on, with plus at $20/month and pro at $50/month; the ai bill remains separate.[^8][^9] compare the total arrangement you need, rather than the word "free" on either download. if you choose a signed-in ai for dusk, check the provider's current terms too.

sections.h: page text can try to steer an agent
sections.md:
brave disclosed an indirect prompt-injection vulnerability in comet page summarisation on 20 august 2025 and reported it to perplexity.[^13] that is a dated disclosure, not evidence from a current exploit test. we have not retested it or established the present patch status.

when evaluating either tool, separate the material it reads from instructions you actually gave it. for dusk, you can watch the bot's screen, take control for sign-ins and stop it. sending in your name has its own approval setting.[^6] those controls do not establish immunity to hostile page text. the [computer-control safety guide](/guides/is-it-safe-to-let-ai-control-your-computer) explains what to think through before giving access.

sections.h: try a research handoff with a clear stopping point
sections.md:
a bounded instruction to try is: "read these product pages and write a shortlist. keep a link beside every claim, separate missing information from confirmed facts, and stop before submitting forms." check the links and the shortlist yourself; this page has no measured result for that task.

if you are also weighing the chatgpt option, [chatgpt agent alternatives](/alternatives/chatgpt-agent) explains the move to work. browser assistants and desktop agents overlap, so choose based on the job and the access you want to give, not the category name.

faq.a: the browser is free to download, but perplexity's plan help page says free includes no browser agent queries as of 12 november 2026. pro and max have monthly query limits.[^4]

faq.q: is comet safe to use for agent work?
faq.a: there is a dated brave prompt-injection disclosure from 20 august 2025.[^13] this comparison did not retest it or establish its current patch status. review the access a task needs and keep the first task small enough to inspect.

faq.q: can a dusk bot use its own browser instead of mine?
faq.a: yes. dusk cloud gives each bot a desktop; a bot on your own server can have a private desktop too. you can watch with Screen, use Take control and then Hand control back. using your own mac screen is a separate choice.[^6]
